manifest.name: dsh-stata
manifest.description: 在 DSH 内直接控制 Stata：常驻 Stata 会话、执行命令与 .do 文件、读回结果。Drive a live Stata session from DSH: run commands and .do files, capture output, keep data in memory between calls.
manifest.author: SoldierNo4 (https://github.com/SoldierNo4)

bundle.text:
# dsh-stata：在 DSH 中控制 Stata
#
# 安装本包后自动注册：
#   1. 技能 stata（会话模型 + 常用工作流说明）
#   2. 工具 stata_run / stata_do / stata_status / stata_reset
#
# 插件默认空配置，绝对不会弄崩启动；可选配置（全部可省略）：
#
#   - id: dsh-stata
#     config:
#       stataPath: C:\Program Files\Stata17\StataMP-64.exe   # 指定 Stata 可执行文件
#       sessionDir: E:\stata-session                         # 会话交换目录，默认 %LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-stata
#       defaultTimeoutMs: 180000                             # 单条命令默认超时
#
- insert:
    - id: dsh-stata
      name: dsh-stata
      config: {}

readme.text:
在 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 里直接控制 **Stata**：一个常驻的 Stata 会话，执行命令、运行 `.do` 文件、读回真实控制台输出，数据与估计结果在多次调用之间保留。

> English documentation: [README.en.md](README.en.md)

Stata 官方自动化入口在不少环境下不可用：

| 方案 | 前提 | 实测问题 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PyStata / `StataSO_Main` | 有效许可、无头初始化 | 许可过期即 `SystemError: failed to initialize Stata` |
| 批处理 `/e do file.do` | 有效许可 | 进程直接退出，不产生 `.log` |
| OLE Automation（COM） | `StataOLEApp` 写入 HKLM | Stata 17 默认不注册；每用户 HKCU 注册在部分环境下对 `ole32` 不可见，需管理员权限 |
| **dsh-stata** | 只要能打开 Stata GUI | ✅ 纯文件队列，不需要 COM、不需要管理员、不需要批处理模式 |

`dsh-stata` 不绕过 Stata 的许可校验，它只是在 **可见的 GUI 窗口** 里跑一个轮询 do 文件，因此只要你能手动在 Stata 里执行命令，它就能工作。

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `stata_run` | 在常驻会话里执行 Stata 命令（可多行，支持循环 / `program define` / 注释），返回控制台输出 |
| `stata_do` | 直接运行磁盘上的 `.do` 文件（绝对路径或相对工作目录） |
| `stata_status` | 查看 Stata 可执行文件、会话目录、进程号、就绪状态与交换文件 |
| `stata_reset` | 停止后台命令循环、恢复 Stata 窗口交互；卡死或超时后用它恢复 |

同时注册技能 `stata`：会话模型、常用工作流与排错指引，让 agent 知道“一个会话就是一个数据集”的正确用法。

- 会话跨调用保留：当前数据集、宏、`program define`、`estimation` 结果、`return list`/`r()` 之外的 `e()` 都还在。
- 输出是真实 `Results` 窗口内容：命令回显 + 结果 + 错误码，例如 `r(111);`。
- Stata 报错不会终止会话，下一条命令照常执行。
- 单条命令串行执行，带超时与互斥锁；超时可用 `stata_reset` 恢复。

- Windows（当前版本显式支持；其他平台的 PR 欢迎）。
- 已安装 Stata GUI（Stata 14 及以上，MP / SE / BE 均可）。
- DSH，且 profile 具备插件管理能力（Web 侧栏 **插件** 页，或 Creator 模式下的 `plugin_manager` 工具）。
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`（DSH 自带的运行时即可）。

readme.section: 方式一：DSH 插件页（推荐）
readme.text:
1. 侧栏打开 **插件 / Plugins**。
2. 点 **添加插件 / Add plugin**。
3. 填入其一：
   - Git 地址：`https://github.com/SoldierNo4/dsh-stata`
   - 本地绝对路径：解压/克隆后包含 `package.json` 的目录
4. 点 **安装**，随后 **启用**。

启用了 HMR 的 profile 会立即重组，无需重启。
在 profile 的 `package.json` 依赖里加入本包（`link:` 本地目录或 git 地址），并把 `dsh-stata` 追加到 `dsh.profile.bundles`，然后重启 DSH。插件自身的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会注册工具与技能，无需再改 profile 的 patch 文件。

直接对 DSH 说：

> 用 Stata 载入 auto 数据，跑一下 price 对 mpg、weight 的回归

对应的工具调用与输出：

```text
stata_run: sysuse auto, clear
          regress price mpg weight

. sysuse auto, clear

下一次调用直接接着用内存里的数据：

```text
stata_run: display _N " obs in memory"
→ 74 obs in memory
```

跑已有脚本：

```text
stata_do: analysis/table1.do
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | ✅ | Stata 命令，多行或分号分隔，语法与在 Stata 里键入完全一致 |
| `timeoutSeconds` | integer | ❌ | 最长等待秒数，默认 180，上限 3600 |

返回 `{ ok, output, durationMs, error? }`；`output` 为清理掉日志头尾后的控制台文本。

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | ✅ | `.do` 文件路径，绝对或相对当前工作目录 |
| `timeoutSeconds` | integer | ❌ | 同上 |
无参数。返回会话目录、可执行文件、进程号、`processAlive` / `ready` / `idle` / `lockHeld` 以及交换文件列表。

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `force` | boolean | ❌ | 无法优雅退出命令循环时，直接结束 Stata 进程 |

优雅路径会让 Stata 回到可交互提示符（数据保留）；`force` 路径会丢弃内存中的数据。下一次 `stata_run` 自动开启新会话。

默认零配置即可工作。需要覆盖时，在 profile 的 patch 层里给该行加 `config`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-stata
  config:
    stataPath: C:\Program Files\Stata17\StataMP-64.exe
    sessionDir: E:\stata-session

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stataPath` | 自动探测 | Stata 可执行文件。探测顺序：本项 → 环境变量 `DSH_STATA_EXE` / `STATA_EXE` → `%ProgramFiles%\Stata*` 下最新的 `StataMP-64.exe`、`StataSE-64.exe`、`StataBE-64.exe` 等 |
| `sessionDir` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-stata` | 命令与日志的交换目录；不可写时回退到系统临时目录 |
| `defaultTimeoutMs` | `180000` | 单条命令默认超时，上限 `3600000` |

```text
stata_run(code)
   │ 1. 写入 <sessionDir>/cmd.do（前面加一行 log using response.log）
   │ 2. 删除 <sessionDir>/done.txt
   ▼

- `daemon.do` 以 `quietly { while (1) { ... quietly sleep 100 } }` 常驻轮询，检测到 `stop.txt` 就退出循环并写 `idle.txt`（这就是 `stata_reset` 的优雅路径）。
- 会话目录里的 `.lock` 保证同一会话串行执行；`state.json` 记录 pid 与启动时间，用于判断会话是否仍然存活。
- 实测延迟（Stata 17 MP，Windows 11）：冷启动首条命令 1.5–3.0 秒，之后 0.2–1.1 秒。

| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| `stata_run` 超时 | 命令可能仍在跑；`stata_status` 看 `processAlive`，用 `stata_reset` 恢复（长任务在调用时调大 `timeoutSeconds`） |
| Stata 窗口被手动关闭 | 下一次 `stata_run` 会发现会话失效并重新启动一个 |
| 报错 `Stata was not found` | 设置 `stataPath` 配置项或 `DSH_STATA_EXE` 环境变量 |
| 会话目录不可写 | 用 `sessionDir` 指到一个可写目录（沙箱环境里 `%LOCALAPPDATA%` 可能被限制） |
| 想彻底重置 | `stata_reset`（`force: true`）后重新调用 `stata_run` |

- **Windows only**：可执行文件探测与路径处理按 Windows 写死，其他平台尚未支持。
- **串行**：一个会话同一时刻只跑一个命令块；需要并行请开多个 Stata 实例（不同 `sessionDir`）。
- 不要在命令里执行 `exit` / `quit`，那会关闭 Stata 并中断会话。
- 不要在会话进行中手工编辑会话目录里的 `daemon.do` / `cmd.do`。
- 图形导出请用 `graph export out.png, replace`；直接 `graph` 会在 Stata 窗口弹窗。
- 插件会在本机启动 Stata 进程并按你的命令读写文件，请只运行你信任的脚本。

目录结构：

```text
stata-plugin/
├── cordis.patch.yml        # 注册一行：id dsh-stata
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js            # 插件入口：注册 tools + skill，处理 dispose
│   ├── session.js          # StataSession：目录/进程/锁/日志/优雅收尾
│   ├── tools.js            # 4 个工具的 schema 与执行逻辑
│   └── skill.js            # 加载 skills/stata/SKILL.md 并注册技能
├── locale/{en,zh}.json     # 插件页显示名与描述
├── skills/stata/SKILL.md   # 技能正文
├── test/                   # node:test 单元测试
└── icon.svg
```

Control a live **Stata** session from [DSH (DeepSeek Harness)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): run commands, execute `.do` files, read back the real console output, and keep data in memory between calls.

> 中文文档：[README.md](README.md)

| Approach | Requirement | Observed failure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PyStata / `StataSO_Main` | valid license, headless init | `SystemError: failed to initialize Stata` once the license expires |
| Batch mode `/e do file.do` | valid license | process exits immediately, no `.log` produced |
| OLE Automation (COM) | `StataOLEApp` registered in HKLM | not registered by Stata 17; per-user HKCU registration is invisible to `ole32` in some environments and needs admin rights |
| **dsh-stata** | ability to open the Stata GUI | ✅ plain file queue: no COM, no admin, no batch mode |
`dsh-stata` does not bypass Stata's license check — it drives a **visible GUI window** with a polling do-file, so if you can run a command in Stata by hand, this plugin can run it for you.

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `stata_run` | Run Stata commands in the persistent session (multi-line, loops, `program define`, comments) and return console output |
| `stata_do` | Run a `.do` file from disk (absolute or workspace-relative) |
| `stata_status` | Report executable, session directory, pid, readiness, exchange files |
| `stata_reset` | Stop the command loop and return the Stata window to an interactive prompt; recover from hangs/timeouts |

It also registers the `stata` skill so the agent knows the session model and the usual workflows.

- State persists across calls: current dataset, macros, `program define`, stored estimation results.
- Output is the real Results window: command echo, results, and error codes such as `r(111);`.
- A Stata error does not kill the session; the next command still runs.
- One command block at a time, with timeouts and a mutex; recover with `stata_reset`.

- Windows (the only platform currently supported; PRs welcome).
- A Stata GUI installation (Stata 14+, any edition).
- DSH with plugin management enabled (sidebar **Plugins** page, or the `plugin_manager` tool in Creator mode).
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the bundled DSH runtime is fine).

1. Open **Plugins** in the DSH sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin** and enter either the Git URL `https://github.com/SoldierNo4/dsh-stata` or the absolute path of a local checkout (the directory containing `package.json`).
3. Click **Install**, then **Enable**.

Profiles with HMR recompose immediately; others need a restart. The plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml` registers the tools and the skill — no profile patch editing required.

Ask DSH:

> Load the auto dataset in Stata and regress price on mpg and weight

```text
stata_run: sysuse auto, clear
          regress price mpg weight

. sysuse auto, clear

The next call reuses the data already in memory:

```text
stata_run: display _N " obs in memory"
→ 74 obs in memory
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | ✅ | Commands, multi-line or semicolon-separated, exactly as typed in Stata |
| `timeoutSeconds` | integer | ❌ | Max wait in seconds (default 180, max 3600) |

Returns `{ ok, output, durationMs, error? }`; `output` is the console text with the log banner/footer removed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | ✅ | Path to the `.do` file, absolute or relative to the workspace |
| `timeoutSeconds` | integer | ❌ | Same as above |
No parameters. Reports session directory, executable, pid, `processAlive` / `ready` / `idle` / `lockHeld`, and exchange files.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `force` | boolean | ❌ | Kill the Stata process if it will not leave the loop gracefully |

The graceful path leaves Stata at an interactive prompt (data kept); `force` discards in-memory data. The next `stata_run` starts a fresh session.

Works with zero configuration. To override, add a `config` block to the plugin row in the profile patch layer:

```yaml
- id: dsh-stata
  config:
    stataPath: C:\Program Files\Stata17\StataMP-64.exe
    sessionDir: E:\stata-session

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stataPath` | auto-detect | Stata executable. Order: this key → `DSH_STATA_EXE` / `STATA_EXE` → newest `StataMP-64.exe` / `StataSE-64.exe` / `StataBE-64.exe` under `%ProgramFiles%\Stata*` |
| `sessionDir` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-stata` | Exchange directory; falls back to the temp directory when not writable |
| `defaultTimeoutMs` | `180000` | Default per-command timeout, max `3600000` |

```text
stata_run(code)
   │ 1. write <sessionDir>/cmd.do (prefixed with `log using response.log`)
   │ 2. delete <sessionDir>/done.txt
   ▼

- `daemon.do` loops with `quietly { while (1) { ... quietly sleep 100 } }`; `stop.txt` makes it exit and write `idle.txt` (the graceful `stata_reset` path).
- `.lock` serializes commands within a session; `state.json` stores pid and start time to detect live sessions.
- Measured latency (Stata 17 MP, Windows 11): 1.5–3.0 s for the first command after a cold start, 0.2–1.1 s afterwards.

| Symptom | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| `stata_run` timed out | The command may still be running; check `stata_status`, then `stata_reset` (raise `timeoutSeconds` for long jobs) |
| Stata window closed by hand | The next `stata_run` detects the dead session and starts a new one |
| `Stata was not found` | Set the `stataPath` config or the `DSH_STATA_EXE` environment variable |
| Session directory not writable | Point `sessionDir` at a writable folder (some sandboxes restrict `%LOCALAPPDATA%`) |
| Full reset | `stata_reset` with `force: true`, then call `stata_run` again |

- **Windows only** for now (executable detection is Windows-specific).
- **Serial**: one command block per session at a time; parallel work needs multiple sessions with distinct `sessionDir`.
- Never call `exit` / `quit` — it closes Stata and kills the session.
- Do not edit `daemon.do` / `cmd.do` inside the session directory while a session is active.
- Use `graph export out.png, replace` for images; a bare `graph` opens a Stata window.
- The plugin launches Stata and reads/writes files on your machine — only run scripts you trust.

readme.text: npm test

```text
stata-plugin/
├── cordis.patch.yml        # registers the plugin row
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js            # entry: register tools + skill, handle dispose
│   ├── session.js          # StataSession: dirs, process, lock, logs, shutdown
│   ├── tools.js            # schemas and execution for the four tools
│   └── skill.js            # loads skills/stata/SKILL.md
├── locale/{en,zh}.json     # plugin manager display metadata
├── skills/stata/SKILL.md   # skill body
├── test/                   # node:test unit tests
└── icon.svg
```
